mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.3 percentage points signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage growth and corporate pricing power, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces discretionary spending and drags on corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 1% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 0.4 percentage points signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the consumer price index exceeding 2% signals a deflationary shock, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).
